title: silicone pastry mat
text: silicone pastry mat. This worked perfectly for rolling out pie crusts and cookies a like.  I really love that you can easily wash it off, dry it and then roll it up to put in a drawer.  It can be washed in the dishwasher per instructions, but I did hand wash as it was so easy.  It provided a nice surface protection while rolling or even just as an easy cleaning option for counter space when you are mixing stuff.  I really do love the ease of use and ease of storage.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Norpro White Silicone Pastry Mat with Measurements
features: Nonstick, easy release without using grease
Promotes even heating when used as a liner
description: A versatile multi-purpose kitchen tool, this pastry mat from Norpro is flexible and easy to use. Fabricated from white silicone with blue accents, it is durable and long-lasting. With a nonstick, easy release without grease, it is perfect for rolling out dough or baking cookies. Featuring measurements in inches and centimeters on the sides, it is non-absorbent and will not retain odors. When used as a tray liner, it promotes even heating and is heat safe up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit. It is dishwasher safe, making cleanup a breeze.
